prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: high-fidelity strictly flat 2D Windows desktop icon for Mutagen Panel, a bidirectional file synchronization utility. Create a new finished icon matching the actual app's monochrome graphite UI. Exact palette direction: rounded-square tile solid off-white #FAFAFA with a subtle thin flat outline #D9D9D9; foreground solid graphite #171717. Transparent canvas outside the tile. The central symbol is TWO SEPARATE BOLD HORIZONTAL ARROWS, one above the other: upper arrow points RIGHT, lower arrow points LEFT. Both arrows have equal visual weight, matching lengths and broad crisp arrowheads, generous spacing and thoughtfully softened corners. This must unmistakably communicate two-way data synchronization between local and remote, with opposing directions, NOT a circular refresh or reload loop. No additional objects are needed. Art direction: premium minimal Swiss geometric icon design, precise alignment, elegant proportions, balanced negative space, refined rounded joins, exceptionally clean contour quality. Tile occupies about 90 percent of the square canvas; arrows occupy about 62 percent of canvas width centered as one balanced symbol. Strictly solid 2D fills, absolutely NO 3D, shadows, gradients, texture, highlights, bevels, reflections, lighting, perspective or material effects. No blue, cyan or other saturated colors. No text, letters, badges, watermark, scenery or mockup. High-resolution clean alpha output suitable for conversion to Windows ICO at 16-256 pixels. A single icon only.
refinement_prompt: Edit this flat application icon. Preserve the existing light off-white rounded-square background, two dark graphite horizontal arrows with upper pointing right and lower pointing left, their geometry, positioning, palette and flat graphic style. Fix only the outer silhouette and transparency: remove ALL stray white specks, flecks, rough fragments and ghost outlines outside the rounded square. Make the rounded-square outline perfectly smooth, clean and continuous with a thin uniform light gray stroke. Everything outside that single outline must be fully transparent with clean antialiased edge pixels only. Maintain solid flat fills, no shadows, no bevels, no 3D, no gradients. Deliver a pristine production desktop icon.
